author: Kevin B. Liu
status: Independent first native draft; CPU source/mechanical tests required separately from pending strict visual qualification.

source.ownership: Two fused material owners, body mesh_324 and tread mesh_325. Whole-vehicle gate only; component segmentation is not inferred from the filename.
source.use: Local-only authoring/comparison. No supplied vertices, indices, textures, archive or loader are eligible for the runtime or public distribution. Historical provenance is not a redistributable license.

canonicalFrame.reason: The arbitrary FBX export scale has no trustworthy metric unit. A fixed3.59m configuration-width instrument was approved before candidate construction; this is not a claimed measured historical prototype specification. Center the independently identified original main tub and use actual track ground. No candidate fitting.
canonicalFrame.scaleUncertainty: All metric scalar values inherit the chosen width anchor; configuration-specific real-world dimensions may differ.

physicalDatums.turretInference: Source lower casting's16 bottom perimeter points support a1.0588244m circle with maximum1.50mm residual. This establishes a design joint, not an alleged source rig node.
physicalDatums.trunnionInference: Measured circular cannon axis, with longitudinal pivot at the widest original canvas/mount shoulder.
physicalDatums.boreConvention: Physically circular125mm native bore; exterior axial spans and actual source recessed floor retained. The runtime firing marker is restored after shared gun construction.

runningGear.physicalDeparture: Whole native animated lanes placed12mm outward. Source left band-to-tub air is only about2mm, right about9mm; the documented correction provides positive native corridor clearance without changing pad width, end radii, axle heights or longitudinal stations. Wheels, end drums and shoes remain one real animated assembly.
runningGear.hiddenReturnRollers: Three small supporting rollers are mechanically inferred where source fused side skirts conceal the return support. Their size/height is constrained by the original visible return-course envelope; they are not claimed directly measured source pieces.

authoredForms: Independent rising belly/narrow tub and source-stepped crowned end guards, separate thin side leaves.
Independent longitudinal cast sections, ten folded cheek modules with genuine internal air and separate permanent supports.
Six actual named reactive fields; roof cells and covers use exact authored triangle hits. Fixed tub, casting, case carriers and drum supports survive spent/reset.
Source-canted side cases, separate rear box, twin transverse drums with correctly oriented retaining hoops and open center gap.
Coherent level source AA receiver/barrel on its real elevated supporting assembly, not a marker-only weapon.
limitations: Source low-polygon silhouettes are original comparison input, not evidence of exact real-world anatomy.
Fine fasteners, cloth folds and grille perforations remain simplified; no full visual pass is claimed before fresh registered views.
Hidden ERA carrier closure and return supports are documented mechanical inferences. Protection values remain gameplay conventions, not inferred protection performance.
